<script>
(function () {
  function fire(name, params) {
    try { window.gtag ? window.gtag('event', name, params) : (window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []).push(['event', name, params]); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function once(key) {
    try { if (sessionStorage.getItem(key)) return false; sessionStorage.setItem(key, '1'); return true; } catch (e) { return true; }
  }
  var active = 0, timer = null;
  function stop() { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
  function engaged() { if (once('bl_engaged')) fire('engaged_session', { value: 1, currency: 'USD' }); stop(); }
  function tick() { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') { active++; if (active >= 30) engaged(); } }
  function start() { if (!timer) timer = setInterval(tick, 1000); }
  start();
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { document.visibilityState === 'visible' ? start() : stop(); });
  function countPage() {
    var n = 0;
    try { n = parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem('bl_pages') || '0', 10) + 1; sessionStorage.setItem('bl_pages', String(n)); } catch (e) {}
    if (n >= 2) engaged();
  }
  countPage();
  var _push = history.pushState;
  history.pushState = function () { _push.apply(this, arguments); countPage(); };
  window.addEventListener('popstate', countPage);
  var OK = /(^|\.)(hubspot\.com|hsforms\.net|hsforms\.com)$/;
  function host(o) { try { return new URL(o).hostname; } catch (e) { return ''; } }
  function onMessage(e) {
    if (!OK.test(host(e.origin))) return;
    var d = e.data;
    if (!d) return;
    if (d.type === 'hsFormCallback' && d.eventName === 'onFormSubmitted') {
      if (once('bl_lead')) fire('generate_lead', { value: 50, currency: 'USD' });
    }
    if (d.meetingBookSucceeded) {
      if (once('bl_demo')) fire('book_demo', { value: 500, currency: 'USD' });
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('message', onMessage);
  function hookFrames() {
    var fs = document.querySelectorAll('iframe');
    for (var i = 0; i < fs.length; i++) {
      try {
        var w = fs[i].contentWindow;
        if (w && fs[i].contentDocument && !w.__blHooked) { w.__blHooked = true; w.addEventListener('message', onMessage); }
      } catch (err) {}
    }
  }
  hookFrames();
  setInterval(hookFrames, 1000);
})();
</script>
